aboutUs.storyContent: BakeryHouse was founded on the basis of commitment and vision to provide Laos with its own Lao bakery brand. With the intention to participate in competition and participate in the bread market both inside and outside Laos, in addition, our company has production plant standards approved by FDA (Food and Drug Administration) to build confidence for all types of consumers, all ages. Furthermore, BakeryHouse also cooperates with GMP organization to upgrade BakeryHouse's bread production plant to an international level.
